query:
SELECT e.chat_id, e.project_id, COUNT(*) FROM chat_events e
         WHERE e.id > COALESCE((SELECT r.event_id FROM chat_user_reads r WHERE r.user_id = ?1 AND r.chat_id = e.chat_id), 0)
           AND (e.sender_user IS NULL OR e.sender_user != ?1)
           AND (e.sender_user IS NULL OR e.sender_user NOT IN (SELECT blocked FROM blocks WHERE blocker = ?1))
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_user_archive a WHERE a.user_id = ?1 AND a.chat_id = e.chat_id)
           AND (
             e.chat_id IN (SELECT chat_id FROM people_members WHERE member = ?2 AND left_at IS NULL)
             OR e.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE user_id = ?1)
             OR e.project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM project_members WHERE user_id = ?1 AND left_at IS NULL)
           )
         GROUP BY e.chat_id ORDER BY MAX(e.id) DESC
index: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS chat_events_project ON chat_events(project_id, id) WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.visibility: Sparse sees two people groups (one archived) and two project chats. Broad additionally joins every group and, for mixed history, every legacy project.
assumptions.mix: People history20events/group; mixed adds one valid legacy project chat with20events per group-agent project, making about half events project-tagged.
assumptions.read_filtering: Shared original read marks, own/blocked/NULL senders, archived room and owner/guest OR scopes; timestamps span under seven days. Proportions are declared synthetic, not observed production.
assumptions.measurement: Warm readonly single-reader bundled SQLite with scanstatus. Python ctypes preparation/binding/column consumption included; native mapping/mutex/writers/network/UI excluded. Two fresh identical fixtures per arm; all deleted afterward.
